scope: One merchant operator with multiple owned stores; local signed fixtures, loopback HTTP and Sandbox-only adapter. Not authentic provider execution, shared-app installation, customer SaaS or deployed HTTPS.

validation.command: /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.13 -B with socket.socket.connect patched to reject any address outside 127.0.0.1, localhost or ::1; unittest loadTestsFromNames tests.test_monitor_connectors, tests.test_monitor_store, tests.test_monitor_http

findings.title: Reused commerce secrets allowed cross-store relabeling of valid signed bodies
findings.reproduced_before_fix: Local Woo HTTP fixture accepted unchanged signed body into another store sharing a secret after route/unsigned headers changed. Equivalent parser relabeling observed for Shopify.
findings.fix: Refuse ingestion/readiness for every store sharing a commerce signing secret; separate custom-app/webhook secret per store required.
findings.fresh_evidence: Both platforms: reused key returns503 before mutation; distinct key wrong-store replay401 and no persisted order; valid correct-store delivery200. Actual loopback HTTP regression in test_shared_commerce_secret_refuses_relabelled_delivery_for_both_platforms.

residual_public_ingress_blockers.cause: Captured valid same-store body can be replayed with varied unsigned delivery IDs to amplify receipt rows.
residual_public_ingress_blockers.required: Define and exercise request rate/concurrency bounds and receipt retention/content deduplication before public ingress.
residual_public_ingress_blockers.scope_effect: No additional blocker for current loopback single-operator slice.
